description: Canonical deterministic disruption families for context-aware itinerary repair benchmarks.

families.description: Weather risk or feasibility worsens for an already scheduled stop.
A day route or required road segment becomes unavailable and requires route revalidation.
A lodging assignment becomes unavailable and may require explicit booked-lodging relaxation.
A scheduled attraction closes or enters an opening-window conflict.
The traveler lowers daily driving or pace tolerance after accepting the parent itinerary.
The traveler adds a new must-visit stop that must be considered in a child repair.
